messages:
Anya K.: Quick callout  need to lock the webinar slate today. I'm proposing three angles: 1) engineering deep-dive on cost vs latency tradeoffs, 2) customer case study (embeddings search at scale), 3) ops lightning: failovers + rollouts. Pick two main tracks + one lightning.
Mike R.: I pick 1 + 2. Ops lightning can be the short wrap.
Tess S.: +1. Also let's mandate a prerecorded demo fallback. Last webinar our live bench died and we lost momentum.
Oliver L.: I'll host the customer story and hand off to their engineer for the demo. Who's doing the bench demo recording?
Anya K.: @Mike R. said he'd take bench ownership earlier today  still good? Need a short script and a prerecord.
Mike R.: Yep, I'll record a 90s bench clip showing the quantized model perf and cost numbers. I'll drop raw + edited in /greenroom/webinars/infer-0426.
Tess S.: Rehearsal timeline proposal: Wed 10am PT (host + speaker dry run), Thu 9am PT (tech run with greenroom ops), Fri 2pm PT (dress with full run-of-show). Everyone should attend at least one.
Oliver L.: Wed OK, Thu 9am might conflict for me but I'll make Fri dress.
Anya K.: If you miss the tech run, schedule a 10-minute pre-sync with ops. Routing note: inbound registrants should hit the webinar form that tags leads with `webinar_infer_0426` and forwards to AE queue A. Tess, can you create the form and add a 'Interested in Dedicated' checkbox for sales segmentation?
Tess S.: On it. I'll also draft two launch posts: one product-focused (bench numbers + tips) and one customer-focused (story + outcomes). Plus the confirmation email for registrants.
greenroom-bot: Reminder: upload prerecorded fallback to /greenroom/webinars/infer-0426 by Thu 17:00 PT. Automated captions will run after upload.
Anya K.: Run-of-show (draft):
```
00:00-00:03 Intro + sponsor (Anya)
00:03-00:12 Engineering deep-dive: cost vs latency (Mike)
00:12-00:25 Customer case + live demo (Oliver -> customer eng)
00:25-00:30 Ops lightning: failovers + rollouts (Tess)
00:30-00:40 Live Q&A + CTA (All)
```
Anya K.: Targets: 800 registrants, 200 live, 40 SQLs within 14 days. Launch content: short product post with bench stat and a customer post. Mike, please confirm bench numbers tomorrow.
Mike R.: Will confirm infra numbers. Draft bench stat: "~2.3x tokens/sec at ~25% of baseline cost"  will verify.
Tess S.: I'll produce 2 headline variants and 3 description variants for paid ads (infra/search lookalikes + PM interest). Also need three CTAs on the landing page: Start trial, Contact AE, Request private demo.
Oliver L.: Audience question: focus infra/platform + search teams or broaden to PMs? I think primary infra/search, secondary PMs.
Anya K.: Growth will run two ad sets: infra/search lookalikes and PM interest cohort. Tess, include messaging variants in the asset pack.
Mike R.: Fallback escalation play: if stream errors >2% sustained for >3 minutes, greenroom ops switches to prerecorded bench clip and opens chat-only Q&A. Oliver will act as fallback host.
Anya K.: Action items: Mike - record clip (due Thu 15:00 PT), Tess - build form + copy + ads (due Tue EOD), Oliver - customer slides (due Wed EOD), Anya - finalize run-of-show and send calendar invites. We'll confirm rehearsal attendance in the next thread. :thumbsup:
